key.name: pinned
key.summary: What's pinned to the taskbar, in order
key.description: Each entry is an app's desktop file ID ("org.gnome.TextEditor.desktop") or a role: "role:web", "role:terminal", "role:files" or "role:mail". A role is a slot for whichever app is the default for that job: it opens that app, and the app's windows show under it.

key.name: size
key.description: Small (32 pixels), medium (42) or large (52), with its icons to match. Patrone Settings sets it.

key.name: layout
key.summary: Where the taskbar and its buttons go
key.description: "left": along the bottom, Start and the apps on the left. "center": Start and the apps in the middle. "split": Start on the left, the apps in the middle. "top": along the top of the screen, Start and the apps on the left, menus opening downward. The theme doesn't change it. Patrone Settings sets it.

key.name: start-icon
key.description: "patrone" is the Patrone P in its colors, "orb" a blue orb with a white P. The others take the taskbar's text color: "mono" (the P), "grid" (a grid of dots), "menu" (three lines), "circle", "spark" (a four-pointed star) and "terminal" (a prompt). Patrone Settings sets it.

key.name: color
key.summary: Where the taskbar's color comes from
key.description: "wallpaper": the wallpaper's own hue, dark or light with the style, in the Patrone, Modern and Studio themes. "theme": the theme's own grey. Classic and Royal always keep their own colors. Patrone Settings sets it.

key.name: pin-icons
key.summary: The icons of the web, terminal, files and mail pins
key.description: "patrone": Patrone's own icons for each job (a globe, a prompt, a folder, an envelope), whichever app does it. "app": the icon of the app each one opens. Patrone Settings sets it.

key.name: terminal-app
key.summary: The app the terminal slot opens
key.description: A desktop file ID. Empty: Patrone Terminal, or another terminal if it isn't installed. (Web browser, files and mail follow the system's default apps instead.)

key.name: web-search-url
key.summary: Where web searches from the Start menu go
key.description: "%s" is replaced with the search terms. Opened with the default web browser.
